meta_description:
617 likes, 36 comments - mombae.blogger on October 18, 2026: "I blinked, and my Aarna is SEVEN! 🥹❤️ And that too on the most auspicious day of Ashtami.

Happy 7th birthday to my Devi Maa, my princess.

From the tiny newborn I held in my arms to the beautiful little girl I see today, I wish I could slow down time and soak in every little moment just a little longer. How did seven years pass in the blink of an eye? 🥹

If only I could freeze time, hold on to those tiny fingers a little longer, and keep you little just a little while more. But since I can’t, I’ll keep loving you through every beautiful version of you. ❤️

May Maa Durga always protect you, guide you, and fill your life with love, happiness, courage and endless blessings. 🪷🙏

Happy birthday, my princess. You will forever be my baby, no matter how big you grow. 🧿❤️

#AarnaTurns7 #kidsbirthdayreels #BirthdayGirl #Ashtami #birthdayreels".
